notes:
What's new

- Rich Text (.rtf) now opens as a formatted document: headings, bold, italics, colours, lists, tables and images are laid out on a paper page, with Page Up / Page Down (or the wheel) to turn pages. Raw RTF markup is no longer shown.
- Font collections (.ttc) open with their faces enumerated; Page Up / Page Down switches between the faces in the file.
- Windows Installer packages (.msi) show a real package inspector: product, publisher, product/upgrade/package codes, language, install scope, feature and file counts, install size and signature — read from the MSI database instead of the executable header.
- Update manifests must now be signed: the app refuses an unsigned or tampered update manifest, closing a downgrade path on networks that can intercept downloads.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.26 - 1F complete. Added a RichEdit-backed RTF viewer (formatted text, pagination, wheel/PgUp/PgDn, Ctrl+C copies text not markup), .ttc face enumeration with face switching, and an MSI inspector built on the Windows Installer API (Property table, Feature/File counts, install size, package code). Update signature verification is now mandatory (kRequireSignedManifest). New diagnostics WM_APP+277/278 (font faces) and +279/280 (MSI counts) and +281/282 (RTF pages). tests/windows_native_test.py (35 checks) runs in production_check alongside the release and scenario audits (439 + 55 checks).
